Class TuiGameLog

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.tui.TuiGameLog
public final class TuiGameLog extends Object
Shared, in-memory history of server-pushed game messages for the TUI. Persists across screen transitions so the player keeps the full transcript when the game ends or the lobby reopens.

    • restore

      public void restore(List<String> entries)
      Replaces the whole transcript with entries (server-authoritative, used on reconnect). Replacing rather than appending keeps a same-process reconnect from duplicating lines. Null or blank entries are skipped.
      Parameters:
      entries - the authoritative transcript, or null to just clear the log
